product.name: To Infinity & Aphelion Sydney Wine Dinner
product.shortDescription:
Let's rendezvous at Infinity by Mark Best.
Plan to indulge in four sustainable courses, made by the Young Chef of the Year, Ken Kwok Lee. Your glasses will be charged with Aphelion fine wines.
product.description:
When Chef met Winemaker it was kismet. 

Both sustainably sourced produce - driven. Both handcrafting. Conjuring from raw ingredients food and drink that transforms your experience on the plate and in the glass. 

Plus they just get along! 

Now at long last Rob Mack and Mark Best bring their decades of skill, accolades and delicious indulgence to one night soaring above the busy day-to-day. To be a haven. To slow down, savour and converse with friends new and treasured.

Their skills become your ultimate sky high wine dinner. 

Revolve from 81 floors above Sydney streets to see the four seasons - the City, the Harbour, and the vast Regional inland. 

Plan to indulge in three incredible courses, made by none other than the Young Chef of the Year, Ken Kwok Lee.

Make new friends with your fellow guests in the intimate private dining room. 

Just 17 others plus Aphelion winemaker Rob Mack and co-founder Louise Rhodes Mack will share this evening with you. 

Your glasses will be charged with a parade of seven acclaimed Aphelion wines, culminating with our ultimate expression of Grenache, the Rapture. 

Welcome to a unique experience that combines unbeatable Sydney views, sparkling hospitality, and time to reconnect with great company, the mastery of skill in your glass and on your plate. 


Important Details

 

Infinity by Mark Best

Thursday August 13th, 6pm for 6.30pm


Bespoke menu created by Mark Best

Three courses made for you by Australia's Young Chef of the Year, Ken Kwok Lee.

Accompanied by world-class Aphelion wines.


To Infinity and Beyond Aphelion Menu



On Arrival: 

Oyster Station - freshly shucked at the bar 


Welkin by Aphelion Sparkling Chenin Blanc 2021

 

Starter:

Bay of Fires Cheddar Custard with Chicory Salad & Mandarin Oil 


Aphelion Callow Grenache Blanc 2025

Aphelion Pir Chenin Blanc 2025

 

 

Main:

Slow Cooked Margra Lamb Shoulder - to share 

Roast Parsnips

Roman Beans 

Hand Cut Chips with Salt & Vinegar 


Aphelion Brini Single Site Grenache 2024

Aphelion Hickinbotham Single Site Grenache 2024

Aphelion Wait Single Site Grenache 2024

 

 

Dessert:

Darkest Chocolate Tart 


Rapture 2022

 


Fun

Your hosts for the evening will be Aphelion owners Rob and Louise Mack. 

Be entertained by Rob's stories about making these wines as he introduces each wine with each course. 

This is your chance to ask questions and share your impressions of the matches.

For a bit of fun, we will have the chance to double your order. Yes - this includes becoming a Wine Club member on the night!

Expect:


  • An ever changing, stunning 360 degree backdrop of Sydney and surrounds,
  • Personalised signature sparkling service;
  • Connection to place, the stories behind the plates & wines;
  • An introduction to the tale of the Mack family who coax delicious, balanced, sustainable wines from grapes in McLaren Vale;
  • A bespoke, artistic menu of three courses selected by Mark Best, paired to stunning Aphelion wines.


Which match will inspire you the most?


Join us as we shine a light on exceptional, world-class Grenache and it's versatility in matching delectable cuisine this August at Infinity. 



What Does Your Ticket Include?

⚈ Exquisite Aphelion wines.

⚈ A bespoke menu of three delicious courses selected by Mark Best and prepared by 2026 Young Chef of the Year in the SMH Good Food Guide - Head Chef Ken Kwok Lee.

⚈ An introduction to the wines and story of Louise & Rob Mack and Aphelion Wines.

⚈ Warm hospitality, beautiful surrounds, and a moment of indulgence.


Questions?

For any further questions about the event, please email us at hello@aphelionwine.com.au
